children: US building systems firm's Q3 revenue rose 25% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 rose 26% yr/yr
Company expects FY 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA at or near high end of guidance
Company expects 2026 revenue at or near the high end of $760 mln-$790 mln range
Company sees 2026 adjusted EBITDA at or near the high end of $78 mln-$84 mln
ORGANIC GROWTH - Co said Q3 revenue growth was driven by improved customer activity and a return to organic growth in owner-direct business, per CEO Michael McCann
ACQUISITIONS - Revenue growth included contributions from newly acquired 1901 and CYMCOR businesses, which accounted for $19.3 mln in Q3 revenue
GCR SEGMENT - Significant revenue growth in general contractor relationships segment, with both organic and acquisition-related gains
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Limbach Holdings Inc is $80.00, about 70.5% above its November 2 closing price of $46.93
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
